description: Renders the project offline to an audio file (no audio device needed). The output's extension picks the format: .wav (8/16/24/32 bit), .flac (lossless and compressed, 16/24 bit, at most 8 channels per file), .aiff (8/16/24 bit), .ogg (Ogg Vorbis, lossy, at most 8 channels) or .mp3 (lossy, mono or stereo, at most 48 kHz). Lossy formats take bitrate_kbps instead of bit_depth. Pass region to bounce a single region instead - always dry, without any clip's gains or fades.

multi_mono.description: Write one mono file per channel instead

output.description: Output path ending in .wav, .flac, .aiff, .ogg or .mp3 - the format follows the extension

project.description: Path to the .audium project package (absolute paths recommended)

region.description: Bounce this region instead of the whole project

track.description: Track id, to disambiguate same-named regions

name: export_audio
title: Export audio
